entries.title: Stale family-contract violation shell hid available zero-shear cleanup
entries.root_cause: A stale family-contract violation/default publication shell could survive after the combined overdesign ladder selected a current shear cleanup action, causing the published card to show a blocked/error state instead of the family-owned cleanup action.
entries.fix_summary: Publication recovery now recognises current cleanup action payloads for COMBINED_OVERDESIGN, restores the enabled cleanup CTA/update payload, and keeps selected, published, and CTA family identity aligned.
